cohort: 237 pregnant women, of whom 173 met the inclusion criteria, undergoing routine prenatal care
finding: Cervical length less than 3cm at 20-24 weeks gestation was associated with preterm birth and vaginal delivery, while cervical length greater than 4cm was associated with postdated pregnancy and increased cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cervical length less than 3cm at 20-24 weeks gestation was associated with vaginal delivery, while cervical length greater than 4cm was associated with an increased rate of cesarean section.
